thread:
Priya: quick FYI — ran a full concurrency sweep on the eval-harness against redwood/open-13b-quant after the kv-prefetch change landed in runner 2.3.1. Observed ~22% drop in tokens/sec and p99 jumped 180ms -> 420ms. cost_per_token up ~35%. dashboard: https://go.redwood.dev/d/abc123/kv-prefetch-sweep
Ashley: ugh. when did that change land? commit/PR?
Sam: it merged yesterday, PR #4269. The change prefetches KV for upcoming tokens and also bumps the batching window from 8ms -> 25ms to improve GPU packing.
Eva: logs from the failing eval job 2026-03-10_21:10 attached:
```
[runner] INFO start sweep concurrency=8
[runner] WARN batching window=25ms, collecting 4 requests
[runner] ERROR latency p99=420ms tokens/sec=4123 cost_per_tok=0.00083
```
ci-bot: eval-job 61234 failed: tests/throughput/sweep.py::test_concurrency_sweep — see https://ci.redwood.dev/61234
Nate: possible hypothesis: prefetch changes increase KV cache churn and cause more cache misses which disable cached prefix reuse, so batching benefits reversed. Need KV hit-rate by request id / prefix.
Priya: can someone run a targeted run that logs `kv_hit_rate` and `batch_size_distribution`? command suggestion:
```
PYTHONPATH=./tools python ./tools/eval_runner.py \
  --model redwood/open-13b-quant \
  --concurrency 8 \
  --trace-metrics kv_hit_rate,batch_size_distribution \
  --duration 300
```
Ashley: started that locally — getting `kv_hit_rate ~ 0.12` vs baseline `~0.78`.
Eva: config diff from PR #4269:
```
- batching.window_ms: 8
+ batching.window_ms: 25
+ kv.prefetch_ahead: 64
```
Sam: that `prefetch_ahead=64` looks aggressive for short prompts; it likely evicts useful cache entries and increases cache churn. Lowering to 8 should reduce evictions.
Priya: agree. plan: revert `batching.window_ms` to 8 and set `kv.prefetch_ahead` to 8 in a hotfix branch, run the full concurrency sweep, and if stable, ship patch. Ashley please open PR and run CI.
Ashley: filing PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/4287
ci-bot: PR 4287 created and CI job 61242 queued.
Nate: also let's add a metric in the harness reporting `cost_per_token` normalized to baseline and alert if >20% regression — we should gate eval-CI on that.
Priya: yes — add to dashboards and eval-ci gating. I'll create a follow-up ticket.
Eva: quick note — quantized kernel selection might interact here; adding a kernel-level trace next sweep to rule that out.
Ashley: local retest with `prefetch_ahead=8` shows throughput back to ~baseline and p99 ~190ms.
Priya: great. ETA to merge once CI passes?
Ashley: CI green for job 61242, merging now. :tada:
ci-bot: merged PR 4287 into main (sha abcdef1). Canary rollout started to ded-1 nodes.
Sam: will monitor the canary dashboards — ops is watching p95/p99 and cost_per_token.
Priya: thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) add kv metrics to eval harness (Nate), (2) gating rule on normalized cost_per_token >20% (Priya), (3) add note to model-onboarding checklist about default prefetch/batching values (Eva).
Ashley: filing the follow-ups as issues.
